name: Unhappy Marriages
overview: Scripture reveals that marriage is a sacred union ordained by God, where a man and woman become one flesh, as established in Genesis 2:24 and affirmed in Matthew 19:6. A godly marriage is a blessing, with Proverbs 18:22 highlighting the favor found in a righteous wife. However, God hates the breaking of this covenant, warning against treacherous dealings and divorce except in cases of fornication (Malachi 2:16; Matthew 19:9). Believers are called to follow God's example in love and faithfulness, reflecting His holiness in their marriages (Ephesians 5:1).
